mentions.name: Rank
mentions.description: Rank is a programming language designed to be comfortably written on a phone, combining ideas from BASIC and APL with array operations, words instead of special symbols, and data-first function calls. Its creator is also considering a dedicated handheld device with a physical QWERTY keyboard and multi-function keys like the ZX Spectrum had.
mentions.problem: Writing code comfortably on a phone is difficult with existing programming languages.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Rank - a language I could comfortably write on my phone. I'm even thinking about making a dedicated handheld with a physical QWERTY keyboard and multi-function keys like the ZX Spectrum had
mentions.author: kmmbvnr_
